title: Bug 637507: [master] [Report 743 VAT Reconciliation Report] Incorrect VAT Base and Amount when using Non-Deductible VAT
summary: The VAT Reconciliation Report now includes a configurable option to report either the total VAT amount including non-deductible VAT or only the deductible portion, addressing cases where non-deductible VAT was previously always included.
key_points: Added a new 'VAT Amount Type' option to the report for users to select between reporting modes
Users can now choose to report deductible VAT only instead of always including non-deductible VAT
New enum 'VAT Reconciliation Amount Type' created to support the reporting option
Test scenarios added to verify both reporting options work correctly
quote: Added a "VAT Amount Type" option to the report letting the user choose between including Non-Deductible VAT or reporting deductible VAT only.
